content:
Incumbent Ricardo "Rick" Rangel has won re-election to the Laredo City Council in District II, edging challenger Daisy Campos Rodriguez by 198 votes.

Rangel received 2,641 votes, or 51.95%, to Campos Rodriguez's 2,443 votes, or 48.05%, according to the Laredo Morning Times, which reported the election-night results on November 4.

The race was a rematch. The two faced off before in 2022, when Campos Rodriguez won by six votes, 1,956 to 1,950. Rangel sued, claiming illegal votes had been cast. A court ruled that 11 votes were illegally cast and declared Rangel the winner. The Fourth Court of Appeals affirmed that ruling, and the Texas Supreme Court denied Campos Rodriguez's petition for review in January 2024.

Rangel told the paper "the people have spoken" and thanked his supporters. Campos Rodriguez told the paper she plans to return to her legal career and thanked her team and family.

The next Laredo City Council election is in 2030.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, reporting on the District II election results on November 4, 2026.

title: Rangel beats Campos Rodriguez by 198 votes to keep District II seat
